accepted_causal_chain: Rerun142 is an exact-current-identity, exact-party, MaxActiveCohorts=1 immutable canary with verified cleanup and immutable DVC publication, but it timed out after 13 of 14 route terminals, three real boss deaths, and a started but incomplete High Priestess Azil encounter.

The official final-row-per-(bot_guid,sequence), 3000-ms acquisition-grace reconstruction exactly reproduces 5226/5926 all-hostile retention, 517/5926 healer exposure, and 5017 ms maximum per-hostile dwell.

Route generation 13 alone contributes 4462 eligible samples, 3881 tank-owned samples, 513 of 517 healer-targeting samples, and the 5017-ms maximum dwell. Removing generation 13 yields 1345/1464 retention, 4/1464 exposure, and 2645 ms maximum dwell, passing all three strict Feral gates.

Generation 13 is the twilight flayer packs objective with enrolled entry 42808. Both enrolled objective GUIDs 416 and 417 were confirmed dead by 1785838124890, yet generation 13 remained open for another 723527 ms while the party fought entry 42428.

Entry 42428 is not a generation-13 natural-pack member. The exact route manifest lists it as a High Priestess Azil add for immediate next generation 14, and existing natural-pack enrollment already excludes immediate-next-encounter members from generation 13.

The rerun142 proactive selector repeatedly chose fresh entry-42428 identities because missing this Feral's Thrash aura outranked ten-yard cluster size. Across 104 retained normal proactive area/density rows it changed target 88 times over 103 transitions; 72 mapped selections were entry 42428, zero selected mapped current-objective entry 42808, and no selected target was objective GUID 416 or 417.

Every tactical area target was then unconditionally published through rememberValidationRouteFocus. That promoted a next-encounter add into explicit shared route focus even though the same add is structurally excluded from the current natural pack, diverting current-node focus and making it eligible as current terminal combat work.

Current trash terminal checks exclude only the immediate next boss, not that boss node's explicitly listed adds. Consequently generation 13 remained responsible for continuously spawning Azil followers after its own enrolled pack was dead, concentrating 434 of its 513 healer samples after the second objective death and consuming the route budget.

Generation 14 did start at 1785838848417 and ran for 164653 ms. It emitted 66 boss_started rows and 65 boss_action rows while engaging Azil entry 42333 and add entry 42428. It recorded zero official healer-targeting samples and 2645 ms maximum dwell, but the external timeout arrived before Azil died.

The smallest evidence-supported correction is one consistency repair across tactical target selection and route ownership: rank actual ten-yard density before Thrash freshness, do not publish a non-current-objective tactical density target as shared route focus, and stop treating explicitly classified immediate-next-encounter members as blockers for the current trash terminal after the current enrolled pack has cleared. The next boss node still owns and must defeat those adds and Azil under unchanged strict route and real-death gates.
